Can I use Tenorshare Cleamio for free? What are the limitations of the free version?

Yes. Cleamio offers free, forever-available basic features—no account or registration required. With the free version, you can:
• Run one-click scans to detect and clean system cache, app logs, and other junk files
• Scan duplicate files and similar photos, and delete up to 15 items for free
• Use the AI File Renaming feature 10 times
• View real-time system monitoring (CPU, memory, disk, network), though startup-item management requires a paid license

The free version helps you fully experience Cleamio before upgrading. It’s ideal for light cleanup needs. To unlock all premium features, simply purchase a subscription plan.
